dashboards.name: Airbnb: East vs West Berlin
dashboards.description: Airbnb listings across East and West Berlin — price, capacity and bed counts broken down by property type (Apartments, Houses, Hotels/Hostels) and neighbourhood. Single-view dashboard.
exampleQuestions: Is the average number of beds for Houses higher than that of All types, Apartments, and Hotels/Hostels?

dashboards.name: Netflix Movies & TV Shows
dashboards.description: Netflix's catalog of ~6,200 movies and TV shows — distribution by country, content rating, genre, and year, with a Type (Movie/TV Show) filter. Single-view dashboard.
exampleQuestions: According to the Movies and TV Shows Distribution, what percentage of the Netflix catalog are Movies?
Which genre has the most titles in the Top 10 Genre chart, and how many titles does it have?

dashboards.name: Spotify Top 100 Songs
dashboards.description: Audio features (danceability, tempo, energy, loudness, acousticness...) of Spotify's top 100 songs, with a per-artist filter and song list. Single-view dashboard.
exampleQuestions: In the 'Number Of Songs By Artist' bubble chart, which artist appears to have the most songs?
Use the Artists dropdown to select 'Ed Sheeran' and list the songs shown in the 'All songs by Artist' table.

dashboards.name: Video Game Sales
dashboards.description: Global video game sales by publisher, genre, and year — Nintendo, EA, Activision and more. Click a genre bar to filter. All questions answerable on the visible view.
exampleQuestions: Which publisher has the highest total sales in the Top 5 Publishers chart?
In the Top 10 Games by Sales chart, which single game has the highest global sales?

dashboards.name: US Flight Delays & Cancellations
dashboards.description: US flight delays and cancellations by airport and state — delayed/cancelled counts, average delay by cause, and per-airport breakdowns. Single-view dashboard.
exampleQuestions: In the 'Cancellations by airport' chart, which airport has the most cancelled flights, and how many?
What is the 'AVG Delay Time' value shown in the KPIs at the top of the dashboard?

dashboards.name: Data Science Salaries (US)
dashboards.description: US data-science job salaries by experience level, company size, employment type, and remote ratio (2020-2022). Single-view dashboard.
exampleQuestions: In the 'Average Salary Trends (2020-2022)' chart, which experience level has the highest average salary?
Using the Remote Ratio filter, set it to 100 (fully remote) and describe how the average salary trends change.
